label: Time to rate the sample export
means: archive_load on the fictional sample, in milliseconds
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-20: a member's first rating should feel instant; the sample is 47 rows
source: latest: one archive_load of tools/sample-export.mjs in a scratch folder

label: Core rows kept even on a spam page
means: Core rows that stay SKIP on a page showing spam, a freelance site and no mutuals
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-20: a core contact is never removed, whatever the page shows
source: state: liveVerdict on every core row of the sample against a spam page

label: Queued rows kept without live proof
means: Queued rows that stay SKIP when the page proves nothing; pitches and your marks need no page
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-20: an export can be years old, so nothing goes on the export alone
source: state: liveVerdict on every queued row of the sample against a page with no proof

label: Tokens per checked row
means: connections_check_list answer per row, characters divided by 4
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-20: first run measured 28; keeps a 20-row screen under 600 tokens

label: Ledger agrees with states
means: Removed and skipped marks match the ledger; a later mark on a removed row is refused
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-20: a removal is final, and the ledger is the record
source: state: scripted marks on the sample

label: Tokens in one summary
means: One connections_summary answer, characters divided by 4
goal_source: Linken, 2026-11-20: first run measured 116; an agent reads it every chunk
source: state: one connections_summary answer on the sample
